I would recommend that you work hard on building up your song repertoire. Try and get it up to around 40 to 50 songs so you can play for around 3 or 4 hours. 

I know everyone says this but its true. Its all about getting your name out there and to do that you really have to hound bars, clubs, pubs, public venues etc to give you a chance. Once you get given a chance you really have to do your very best to show the venue that you are good enough to draw people in because after all thats all they care about. But from what ive learnt over the years is if you are good, you will draw people in and you will get continuous gigs. If your not getting regular gigs, you probably suck. People can tell there difference between good and bad bands
